name: deflate
algorithm: Raw DEFLATE (RFC 1951) compress-then-decompress round trip over a generated mixed text buffer in memory at each std library's default compression level, verifying exact decompressed byte length and FNV-1a 64 checksum on every round (README.md).

skip.rust: no std deflate/gzip in Rust (flate2 is a crate)
skip.mk-wrap: the checksum already uses the wrapping operators; there is no checked arithmetic to remove

no_counts: B24 does not apply: an idiomatic row compares standard library DEFLATE encoders and decoders, which may emit different valid RFC 1951 bitstreams; every round verifies exact output length and FNV-1a 64 equality against the original source bytes
notes: All four columns run raw RFC 1951 DEFLATE at their standard default compression level (Mk std.compress.Deflate/Inflate, Zig std.compress.flate Compress .default/Decompress .raw, Go compress/flate DefaultCompression/Resetter, C# System.IO.Compression.DeflateStream CompressionLevel.Optimal).

Each round verifies that decompression reproduces the exact source byte length and FNV-1a 64 checksum (exiting non-zero on any mismatch), folds checksum + length, and flips one source byte via XOR 0x01 so no round can be hoisted.
